1. Bot token (one time only)
• Open Telegram and search @BotFather
• Send /newbot, choose any name and a username ending in "bot"
• BotFather replies with a token like 123456:ABC-xyz… Copy and paste it here.

2. Pack link
• In Telegram open a sticker pack → ⋮ → Share / Copy link
• Paste it here (or share it directly to StickerBridge)

3. Tap Import, then "Add to WhatsApp".

Notes
• WhatsApp allows max 30 stickers per pack, so big packs are split.
• Static and animated stickers go into separate packs (WhatsApp rule).
• Your token stays on your phone and is only sent to api.telegram.org.
